He worked it free with numb fingers. Inside, a single page, salt-stained, the ink feathered but legible. A sailor, decades gone, had written only that he was happy, that the stars above his small boat were enough. No name, no plea, no coordinates. The keeper read it twice, then set it on the windowsill where the lamp turned. For years he had sent light outward and received nothing back. Now the ocean had answered, late and strange, and he found he was smiling at the empty horizon.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没醒。路灯一盏接一盏，把空街照得发白。送奶车慢慢驶过，轮胎压过积水，声音很轻。便利店亮着灯，店员趴在柜台打盹。清洁工开始扫落叶，扫帚声一下一下，规律得像呼吸。高楼大多黑着，只有零星几扇窗透出光，不知是失眠的人，还是还没下班的人。天边微微泛青，鸟还没叫。整座城安静地停在白天和黑夜的缝里，等一个新的早晨到来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by doing a tiny bit, then asking a smaller copy of itself to do the rest.\n- Like looking in two facing mirrors: each reflection holds a smaller reflection, again and again.\n- It must stop somewhere, so there's always a smallest, easiest case that answers right away without asking again."}
